newsitem.title: UK: March Ekofisk programme 31 cargoes - trade.
newsitem.headline: March Ekofisk programme 31 cargoes - trade.

text.p: Norway's Ekofisk crude oil pipeline system is to load 31 cargoes in March, up five cargoes from February, trade sources said.
The March programme will consist of 15 cargoes of 600,000 barrels each and 16 cargoes of 500,000 barrels each.
A total of 17 million barrels are scheduled to load in March, representing an increase of some 45,000 barrels per day on the February programme.
Ekofisk production in March will be supplemented by crude from the U.K. Fulmar field which has been tied into the Norpipe system which carries Ekofisk to the Teesside terminal in northeast England.
Technical problems delayed the tie-in which was expected to be completed by the end of January.
Most Fulmar loadings continued into February via the old method of offshore tanker liftings, traders said.

The 350,000 barrel per day Ekofisk field was shut in for 28 hours from the morning of Feb 16 while maintenance work was being carried out on an oil pipeline. Equity holders said that while this would not result in any cancellations from the February programme, it may cause loading delays.
The first cargo in the March Ekofisk programme is scheduled to load March 4-6.
